name: pi-nvimotator
description: Pi extension and Neovim plugin for annotating the latest assistant message or a local file from any same-host shell. Claude Code and Codex hosts live in claude/ and codex/ and are not Pi extensions.

scripts.build: npm run build:claude && npm run build:codex
scripts.test:ts: tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.ts claude/tests/cli.test.ts claude/tests/plugin.test.ts claude/tests/claude-session.test.ts codex/tests/cli.test.ts codex/tests/plugin.test.ts codex/tests/codex-session.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:ts && npm run test:nvim && npm run build && node claude/cli.bundle.js --help >/dev/null && node codex/cli.bundle.js --help >/dev/null && npm run test:bundle
